children: Tianci International announced a non-binding MOU with BTC Digital to pursue a phased ~3 MW crypto computing project.
MOU signed Sept 11, 2026; press release furnished Sept 15, 2026 describing cooperation on a ~3 MW project.
Project target: deploy an aggregate electrical load of approximately 3 MW within 12 months after MOU effective date.
BTC Digital to provide or coordinate sites, power, hosting, equipment deployment and operational support.
Tianci to handle equipment procurement, funding, transportation, insurance and required permits/approvals.
MOU is non-binding, 12-month term, and parties may negotiate definitive hosting or service agreements for tranches.
